page_title: HOF 1-1 AUG | Hoffenheim v Augsburg 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' That will be all from Alexis Claude-Maurice who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).
86' Referee Tobias Reichel signals NO PENALTY for Hoffenheim after a VAR review!

86' Play continues despite the shouts by some Hoffenheim players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tobias Reichel interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
86' One of the Hoffenheim players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
84' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. David Jurasek will be replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim).
80' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fredrik Jensen departs the field of play to be replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
78' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' The attendance for today's match is 21427.
76' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
74' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) heads on.
72' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Marius Wolf and he is replaced by Henri Koudossou (Augsburg).
72' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frank Onyeka.
71' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Finn Dahmen into middle of the goal.
71' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is going to take the penalty!

71' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Hoffenheim.
68' Substitution. Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) in, Bazoumana Toure out.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
63' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for an infringement.
61' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Pavel Kaderabek is replaced by Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim).
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Gift Orban as he is replaced by Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim).
57' Yellow card. Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
56' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
52' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Tobias Reichel stops the game and makes a call.
50' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
47' The game is interrupted. Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Cedric Zesiger laid the ball off to Samuel Essende (Augsburg), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
46' Half-time substitution. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is replaced by Samuel Essende.
46' Referee Tobias Reichel blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
38' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Finn Dahmen was alert and made a comfortable save.
37' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) inside the box.
37' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
34' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
31' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
29' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
28' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tobias Reichel signals.
24' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
22' Rough tackle by Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' A cross into the box finds the head of Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) who steers it goalwards, but Finn Dahmen manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
17' A cross by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
15' Tobias Reichel couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marius Wolf (Augsburg) and blew his whistle.
12' A pass by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
11' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
9' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
5' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
5' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
4' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
